records.evidence_text: The votes have been counted in all 81 divisions for the 2013 Surrey County Council elections; Turnout 30%.
records.notes: Election-wide supplementary turnout only. It is not an official division turnout and is not copied to any division record.

records.source_name: Electoral Commission: Results and turnout at the May 2017 England local elections
records.evidence_text: Table 3.2 lists Surrey ballot-box turnout as 30.0% for 2013 and 35.8% for 2017.
records.notes: Independent election-level corroboration only. It is not copied to any division turnout field.
